title: Residents protest outside National Guard facility in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka

tea.why: Residents gathered following social media reports alleging that servicemen were being illegally detained and beaten inside a private house.
tea.want: Protesters demanded the release of individuals they believed were being held against their will inside the property.
tea.changed: Nov 2: Clashes occurred between protesters and security forces, resulting in the hospitalization of four servicemen and the use of tear gas.

summary: On November 2, 2026, a crowd gathered outside a private residence in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka, Kyiv Oblast, following online claims that mobilized men and soldiers were being held and abused in the building's basement. The property was identified by the National Guard of Ukraine and the 1st Azov Corps as a temporary holding point for servicemen who had left their units without authorization. Protesters attempted to breach the gate and threw objects at law enforcement and military personnel. Authorities, including National Guard commander Oleksandr Pivnenko, denied allegations of illegal detention or torture. Four servicemen were transported to a hospital for medical care. The incident involved scuffles, the use of tear gas, and warning shots fired by security forces. President’s Office Head Kyrylo Budanov arrived at the scene to address the situation.
response: The National Guard stated the house was a legal temporary holding point for AWOL soldiers. Police and the National Guard denied reports of illegal detention or torture, and an internal inquiry and ombudsman review were initiated.

updates.text: Residents gathered outside a house in Petropavlivska Borshchahivka following reports of illegal detentions.
Clashes broke out between protesters and security forces, involving tear gas and warning shots.
Four servicemen were removed from the house and hospitalized; the National Guard confirmed they were AWOL soldiers.

sources.title: Crowd gathers outside house near Kyiv where mobilized troops and AWOL soldiers were being held. Clashes erupt, shots are fired, and Zelensky’s chief of staff intervenes. — Meduza
